meta.title: Fish Panel
meta.description: Adds the local fish-panel (127.0.0.1:8899) to the DSH sidebar: one click embeds the whole page, while the host half launches panel.mjs with DSH, health-checks it every 30s, and exposes status/start/stop routes.

handle.hint: Move the pointer to the top edge to show the status bar
status.notReady: Start finished, but the panel is not ready
hint.needStart: The panel is not running yet. Press Start: the host launches panel.mjs, then embeds it here.
hint.opening: Waiting for the panel to become ready; progress shows in the toolbar.
